verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic coverage of core OneDrive UI actions: addressing items by ID or path, simple and resumable uploads, sharing-link creation, search, thumbnails, version history, delta change tracking, and change notifications. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI-to-API parity, and several UI-facing capabilities have no API evidence, including offline 'Always keep on this device', folder backup, coauthoring, and admin external-sharing configuration. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API coverage for backup, offline, coauthoring and sharing-policy settings, and independent hands-on confirmation of breadth.
